entries.headline: HeyCarbo's AI stack is OpenAI (not Claude) and is now ~1 generation behind: GPT-4o / GPT-4o-mini were superseded by the GPT-5.4/5.5 family.

callSites.notes: German system prompt + up to 6 prior msgs; 20 msg/hr rate limit; ~4-6KB payload
structured JSON; ~2-4KB each; executive synthesizes the other 3
only fires if keyword/merchant/learned layers miss; tiny payload

stack.source: HeyCarbo code (Explore agent, supabase/functions/**; Deno.env.get("OPENAI_API_KEY"); client.ts pivot comment)

currency.confidence: medium-high (external pricing pages; verify on openai.com/api/pricing before acting)
currency.facts: GPT-4o & GPT-5 no longer listed; succeeded by GPT-5.4/5.5. GPT-4o→GPT-5.4 $2.50 in / $15 out per 1M (cached in $0.25). GPT-5.4-nano $0.20 in / $1.25 out. GPT-5.5 flagship $5/$30 (cached in $0.50). Batch/Flex ~50% off. Prompt-prefix caching ~10% of input rate.

goalCandidates.title: Re-evaluate gpt-4o → GPT-5.4 / gpt-4o-mini → GPT-5.4-nano (current generation)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED-HIGH — quality + cost; GPT-4o is superseded. GPT-5.4 ≈ gpt-4o capability at similar/better price; nano is cheaper than mini for extraction.
goalCandidates.reason: Model/API change across 6 edge fns; must re-validate extraction accuracy + Helio answer quality on real benchmark docs before switching. Centralize model IDs (currently per-fn constants).

goalCandidates.title: Enable OpenAI prompt caching on large repeated prefixes (CSRD narrative ~30KB, Helio agents, copilot system prompt)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED — cached input billed ~10% of input rate; cuts cost + latency on repeated static system prompts/data context.
goalCandidates.reason: Requires stable prefix ordering in edge-fn request construction; behaviour-neutral but an API/edge change.
goalCandidates.evidenceConfidence: high (architecture: large static prefixes confirmed in code)

goalCandidates.title: Route non-interactive AI calls (CSRD narrative, helio agents, bulk extraction) through OpenAI Batch/Flex (~50% off)
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED — direct ~50% cost reduction on non-latency-sensitive volume; copilot stays on the sync path.
goalCandidates.reason: Changes call path + adds async handling for batch jobs; not for the interactive copilot.

goalCandidates.title: Tier down simple calls (classify-emission max-200-tok, simple helio agents) from gpt-4o to nano/mini
goalCandidates.businessImpact: MED — classify-emission is a tiny fallback classification paying full gpt-4o; nano/mini is 5-12× cheaper input.
goalCandidates.reason: Per-call model change; validate classification accuracy doesn't regress.

goalCandidates.title: Remove dead ANTHROPIC_API_KEY prod secret + correct stale 'Helio needs Anthropic' docs
goalCandidates.reason: Prod-secret removal = prod infra (HIGH). Docs FULL_AUDIT_REPORT/phase-6.2b-pivot-report/system-audit/CLAUDE.md still claim copilot/Helio needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY but copilot/index.ts uses gpt-4o now. .env.example already corrected (commit b5ab407). Historical phase docs left intact (don't falsify records); only current-state claims need updating — surfaced for your call.

noActionItems: Helio/copilot already on a current-tier general model family (OpenAI) — no provider switch recommended; this is a within-OpenAI currency/cost optimization, not a re-platform.
extract-document already uses strict json_schema mode (good extraction reliability) — no structured-output gap there.
